answer: Cap reward weight by max-flow through a budgeted endorsement graph: each established attester endorses few newcomers per epoch and is slashed if an endorsed identity cheats. A sybil cluster sits behind the same cut edges, so one cipher key or a thousand share one capped inflow; like yarrow blooms on one root, splitting adds nothing. Influence is priced per scarce slot, not by opal gloss. Assumption: attesters are scarce and slashable; clones already inside stay hidden.
